show.title: Kanoon Ka King
show.sharing_text: हेलो! मैंने कुकू एफएम पर इस शो को सुना और मेरे ख्‍याल से आपको भी पसंद आएगा
show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/BGCC2q
show.description: Karan Jethmalani, the secret heir of a powerful company, hides his identity and comes as a simple lawyer to propose to his college friend Sara. But before he can confess his love, Sara accepts the proposal of rich businessman Neel. Karan is insulted and humiliated in front of everyone. Years later Sara’s marriage becomes a nightmare and she is falsely accused of a terrible crime. When she ends up in jail, Karan returns as the most powerful lawyer to save her and expose Neel’s truth.
